en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a dense street procession with crowds lining both sides of a narrow city street. At the front are men in formal dark clothing and hats, some wearing sashes or ceremonial regalia, followed by uniformed participants and flag bearers. The façades are tall European-style buildings with arched windows. The caption at the bottom is printed in both French and Dutch.
